query: UPDATE embedding_jobs SET attempts=attempts+CASE WHEN $6='embedding_admission_busy' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,error_code=$6,lease=NULL,lease_until=NULL,available_at=now()+least(300,power(2,attempts+1)::int)*interval '1 second' WHERE tenant=$1 AND kind=$2 AND object_id=$3 AND revision=$4 AND lease=$5
